text:
maya: Heads-up — onboarded the sample-app (vite + ts) to the ESM SDK today and hit a weird auth/retry loop only when building for edge targets. Works fine in node.

sam: ugh. does it fail during build or at runtime?

maya: runtime. dev server + SSR works. But the deployed edge bundle keeps hitting 401 -> SDK retries -> double-auth header? Not sure. Logs show: 
```
WARN Redwood SDK: auth failed 401
Request headers: Authorization: Bearer xxxxxx
Retrying...
Request headers: Authorization: Bearer xxxxxx, Authorization: Bearer xxxxxx
```

jules: that looks like headers being duplicated on retry. Could be polyfilled fetch in the edge runtime reusing a mutated headers object. Which bundler + target?

maya: vite 5 with esbuild target=esnext, adapter: cloudflare pages edge. Using our ESM entrypoint import { Redwood } from '@redwood/inference' (esm).

alex: interesting — we saw a similar issue where our retry logic was copying the original Request but not cloning headers correctly when running on some edge shims. But why does node not show it? Node fetch clone semantics differ.

noah: can you repro locally with miniflare or wrangler dev? if so we can add an integration test.

maya: repro steps I used:
1) git clone https://github.com/redwood-inference/sample-apps.git -b vite-edge-auth-repro
2) cd vite-ts-edge-auth
3) npm i
4) export REDWOOD_API_KEY=badkey
5) npm run build && npm run preview --target=cloudflare
6) curl -v https://localhost:8787/api/generate

Result: 401 + repeated Authorization header on subsequent retries.

sam: can you paste the tiny repro handler?

maya: Sure: 
```ts
// src/routes/api/generate.ts
import { create } from '@redwood/inference';
const client = create({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY });
export async function post({ request }) {
  const res = await client.generate({ prompt: 'hi' });
  return new Response(await res.text());
}
```

jules: put breakpoint logs in our retry code — maybe headers are a shared object on that runtime. @ci-bot can you run quick CI job with node:edge runtime matrix?

ci-bot: queued job: devex/vite-edge-auth-repro (#1245) — running on cloudflare/workers-v8 distro.

alex: also noticed types oddness: TS language server flags in VSCode show no overload for create() when using the ESM entry in vite, but works if I import from '@redwood/inference/dist/cjs'. That smells like our package.json exports map + types field not matching bundles.

noah: that's a separate but related DX bug — ESM consumers get wrong .d.ts resolution in some bundlers because we ship types only with CJS path. We should ensure exports map points to types for both entries.

sam: for immediate triage: maya, can you try forcing headers cloning in retry to create new Headers(req.headers) and see if it fixes duplication?

maya: did that in local patch — seems to stop duplication locally under miniflare. But still want a minimal repro for CI. I added this snippet to client retry: 
```js
// in retry path
const headers = new Headers(origReq.headers || {});
headers.set('Authorization', `Bearer ${apiKey}`);
const req2 = new Request(origReq, { headers });
```

jules: good. let's add an e2e that uses wrangler dev + bad key expecting retry header not duplicated. Also add a TS test — run tsc against a fresh vite project importing our ESM package to catch types resolution.

alex: FYI, bundler-specific quirk: vite + esbuild may rewrite import.meta.url and do aggressive inlining which can change how our header-cloning util is tree-shaken. Could be multiple root causes.

noah: action items:
- maya: push minimal repro branch with the patch + simple curl check (ETA today)
- jules: add CI job config to run worker-v8 runtime test and tsc check (ETA tomorrow)
- alex: open PR to ensure package.json exports include "types" for ESM entry (ETA EOD)

maya: I'll also include instructions in the sample-app README for how to reproduce with wrangler/miniflare and the specific vite config I used.

sam: thanks. once we have CI green we should consider a tiny hotfix release patch for the retry clone.

maya: noted — will ping here when branch is up. :thumbsup:

ci-bot: job devex/vite-edge-auth-repro (#1245) still running...

maya: One more oddity — when I switch to importing default `import Redwood from '@redwood/inference'` the duplicate header goes away. That points again at ESM vs CJS interop behavior. I logged it in the issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/issues/431

jules: good catch. that'll help narrow whether it's our packaging or runtime.

noah: ok let's reconvene after CI results. thanks all.
